subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable runtime as a permanent core shared-state, environment, CLI, and Gateway protocol contract?
rationale: The PR is not merely an internal refactor: it establishes persistent data, operator flags, public commands, and generated protocol surfaces whose ownership and long-term compatibility require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the core contract
options.body: Accept the durable core as a beta contract after the docs finding is fixed and independently inspectable upgrade, restart, and delivery proof is attached.

options.title: Narrow to an internal prototype
options.body: Retain a smaller internal recording experiment but remove public environment, CLI, docs, and protocol commitments until the model is proven.

options.title: Pause the implementation stack
options.body: Keep the RFC discussion open without merging persistent runtime code until ownership and rollout policy are settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core contract
recommendation.body: Accept the durable core as a beta contract after the docs finding is fixed and independently inspectable upgrade, restart, and delivery proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest merged-history signal across the shared-state and cross-owner runtime foundations affected by the decision.
